families.description: Break the task into subgoals, track progress, and avoid repeated failed actions.
default_steps: identify the next bottleneck
take the smallest action that unlocks progress
update the state after each action

families.description: Use the available tool or action set deliberately and verify preconditions before acting.
default_steps: inspect admissible actions
choose the action with the best information gain
check whether the action changed the state as expected

families.description: Find target objects, locate destination containers, and move objects efficiently.
default_steps: locate the destination early
search likely object locations systematically
return directly once the destination is known

families.description: Use the correct appliance or interaction sequence to clean, heat, or cool an object before delivery.
default_steps: identify the required state change
prepare the appliance before fetching the object
confirm the object state before delivery
default_failure_modes: moving to destination before state change completes

families.description: Use search, filters, and pagination to narrow candidates quickly before inspecting details.
default_steps: extract hard constraints from the user request
use search or filtering to reduce the candidate set
inspect details only after pruning

families.description: Compare shortlisted products against the user constraints and only purchase after verifying all critical attributes.
default_steps: write down the must-have attributes
compare candidates attribute by attribute
purchase only after the best match is confirmed

families.description: Decompose the question into evidence needs, search iteratively, and verify support before answering.
default_steps: split the question into subclaims
retrieve evidence for each subclaim
cross-check the combined evidence before answering

families.description: Detect repeated failed behaviors and switch strategies before the trajectory stalls.
default_steps: notice repetition
identify the failed assumption
try a different branch or tool
